{{Top|leg}}
A '''bond-wife''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] who [[Marriage/Legends|married]] a male of her own [[Species/Legends|species]] and was typically his first wife. Because of a low birth rate, Cereans practiced [[polygamy]], with each male taking many wives. After marrying their bond-wife, several [[Honor-wife|honor-wives]] were taken.
